name: io.github.limccn/longstone
description: Sovereign agent-memory MCP server: sign locally and anchor memories on an Ethereum testnet.

environmentVariables.name: LONGSTONE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Delegated testnet signing key. Never a mainnet or owner key.

environmentVariables.name: LONGSTONE_OWNER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Owner key used only for ACL changes and retract-any.

environmentVariables.name: LONGSTONE_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: JSON-RPC endpoint for the registry chain.
